_comment: Make.com scenario blueprint template for Trigify Engagers pipeline. v2 — VERIFIED 32-column schema (was 17-col v1). Used by lilly-trigify-setup Phase 4b. ONE webhook → ONE addRow (no router, no iterator — Trigify sends one engager per POST). Replace {{spreadsheet_id}}, {{webhook_hook_id}}, and {{google_connection_id}} when cloning. Tab name 'Engagers' is fixed.

_placeholders.{{spreadsheet_id}}: Google Sheet ID (NOT URL, NOT with leading slash here — Make config adds the slash)
_placeholders.{{google_connection_id}}: Make.com Google connection ID — 9696598 for Navreo

_verified_trigify_payload_schema._note: This is the schema Trigify ACTUALLY sends after the Workflow's http_request::pushToClay step runs. The workflow assembles the body from trigger + getComments[N] + enrich[N] steps. To get every field below into Make, the workflow's pushToClay body template must forward all these keys — see Phase 5 of lilly-trigify-setup for the body template patch.
_verified_trigify_payload_schema.postAuthorName: string — TRACKED PROFILE NAME (constant per workflow, must be hardcoded in pushToClay template since the workflow has no source-name lookup. E.g. 'Bjion Henry' on the Bjion workflow.)
_verified_trigify_payload_schema.commentPermalink: string — comment.permalink (deep link to specific comment)
_verified_trigify_payload_schema.engagerHeadline: string — getComments.items[N].author.title (RAW LinkedIn headline including pitch language)

_engagers_tab_columns: C: Post Author Name         (postAuthorName — constant per workflow)
S: LinkedIn URN             (engagerUrn — primary cross-source dedup key)
Z: Company Industry         (engagerCompanyIndustry — primary signal for engager-company gate)
AB: Company Description     (engagerCompanyDescription — secondary signal for engager-company gate)
AC: Country                 (engagerCountry — primary signal for location gate)
AE: Status                  (literal 'NEW' on insert; downstream sets QUALIFIED / BORDERLINE / OFF_BRIEF / PUSHED / OFF_BRIEF_NO_EMAIL)
AF: Raw Payload             (toString(1) — full webhook payload as JSON string for safety)
name: Trigify — {{brief_name}}

_pushtoclay_body_template_required._purpose: Each Trigify Workflow's http_request::pushToClay step has its OWN body template that assembles the POST body from upstream steps (trigger + getComments + enrich). For the Make scenario to see all 32 columns' worth of fields, that body template must be patched to forward every key listed in _verified_trigify_payload_schema above. The patch is per-workflow — needs to be applied to every active workflow (Bjion + 13 founders + 32 employees = 46 workflows for the current Navreo brief; 60+ overall when other briefs are added).

_template_shape.postAuthorName: <HARDCODED per workflow — the tracked profile's name, e.g. 'Bjion Henry' on Bjion's workflow, 'Sacha Martinot' on Sacha's, etc.>

_pushtoclay_body_template_required._template_note: engagerProfilePicture: the author.profilePicture is an array of 4 sizes (100x100, 400x400, 200x200, 800x800). Index 2 in Trigify's observed payload is the 200x200 size; check at template-edit time whether the 400x400 is at index 1 — use whichever index is 400x400. As a robustness fallback, simply pick index 0 (always present).
